label: Adventurers' guild
blurb: A JRPG fantasy world of quests and dungeons: adventurers, guild staff, mage students, summoners and the occasional demon lord.
context: JRPG fantasy adventurers' guild character, vivid and heroic

elf.label: Elf
elf.features: long pointed ears and striking, ageless features

beastkin.label: Beastkin
beastkin.features: a pair of animal ears and a matching tail

demon.label: Demon
demon.features: small curling horns and faintly glowing eyes

dwarf.label: Dwarf
dwarf.features: a stocky, powerful frame and a proudly braided beard

dragonkin.label: Dragonkin
dragonkin.features: faint scale patterns along the jaw and sharp slitted eyes

hobbies: leveling up at the training grounds
quirks: talking to {poss} familiar like an old friend
checking {poss} mana reserves out of habit
keeping a lucky charm from {poss} first quest
counting monster kills in a battered journal
refusing to enter a dungeon on an even-numbered day
arguing with {poss} own reflection about tactics
leaving small offerings at every shrine passed
goals: finding the dungeon that took {poss} mentor
earning enough to retire from questing
clearing the labyrinth no one's returned from
being trusted with an S-rank party
peeves: quest boards picked clean by dawn
party members who skip the briefing
potions that taste like swamp water
nobles who think gold outranks skill
accessories: a guild badge pinned to the collar
a coiled whip at the hip
a small vial of glowing potion
a signet ring from a forgotten house
a familiar's feather tucked in a pocket
a dagger etched with old runes

default_outfits: a hooded mage's robe cinched with a wide belt, soft boots and fingerless gloves
_tables: The next two entries replace the shared tables in common.json for this setting only (same shape): no modern hair dye in a fantasy world (the races already carry unusual natural colours), and a few magic-flavoured distinguishing marks.
